units: Positions mm; volume mm³; inertia at mesh COM for unit density, mm⁵. Multiply by material density in kg/mm³ and 1e-6 for kg·m².
limitations: Source motor has 47 g aggregate mass; its decorative solid subdivisions must not be assigned bulk-metal densities.
Bearing rings, balls and seals are simplified into an envelope; real component mass/inertia still required.
Manufactured parts, inserts, electronics and wires need actual material/component mass assignments before a V2 plant is claimed.
